meta.write: field glue as an a priori
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. Sign of Ẋ is a number. The j*=2 sketch grows. The NS packet falls.

lemmas.name: B30_match_readable
lemmas.statement: model versus NS rates, sign mismatch, and model-grows / field-falls are readable together
lemmas.why: Model Ẋ = +2.25. NS Ẋ ≈ −22.5. Eight steps: model X grows. NS X falls. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B30a_match_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: matching the two-regime sketch to NS Ẋ closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: The sketch pointed up. The field pointed down. A wrong-sign ODE is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B30b_shrink_alpha_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: shrinking α_c until the signs match is a continuation argument for classical X
lemmas.why: Implied α sits near 0 on the packet and ~0.006 on the blob. The sketch used 0.4 and 0.2. Detuning α_c is a knob.

lemmas.name: B30c_wrong_sign_not_ns
lemmas.statement: a typed ODE that grows while the packet falls is still an NS a priori
lemmas.why: B9b is a typed fat cubic. This field cancelled. Do not sit the sketch as the packet.

lemmas.name: B30d_match_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: matching model Ẋ to NS Ẋ is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: A sign of Ẋ is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. A sketch that points the wrong way is not the max criterion.

lemmas.name: B30e_climb_leftover
lemmas.statement: a field climb law closes X
lemmas.why: Scored as B20e / B31. A missing saving rate is not continuation. Climb sketch is not an a priori (B21e). Finer box is not an a priori (B22e). Finer DNS is not an a priori (B23e). Leftover close is not an a priori (B34e). Regularity leftover is not an a priori (B35e). Regularity stays open. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B30f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring field glue as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. α_c is a knob on the estimate: a number you can miss. No Q1. No ε.
